goal: Mechanism consistency and 10-round complete replay; no new acquisition algorithm

sources.name: LendingClub2017
sources.filter: Fully Paid or Charged Off; positive loan_amnt; 21 original decision-time predictors
sources.claim: Previously untouched later cohort; terminal-status retrospective immediate-label replay, not strict as-of

sources.name: SouthGermanCredit
sources.filter: All 1000 records; outcome coding per official R codebook; 20 decision-time predictors
sources.claim: New external benchmark; bad-credit oversampling, transformed amount, no guaranteed borrower identity

model.backend_rationale: GPU/device and user-service access unavailable under current sandbox; CPU specified before inspecting new outcomes, no fallback or outcome-based adjustment

splits: 20% development / 60% replay / 20% sealed test by available entity ID and exact duplicate covariates; deterministic group permutation per seed; no target stratification; preprocessing D0 only; Q_ref development only
initial: First quarter of replay is initial pool; lower half by fixed covariate score forms D0; remaining initial-pool rows stay unused
business: D0 LR, frozen threshold at 70th percentile of development predictions; frozen costs PD times exposure/D0 mean; candidate cap shared uniform feature-only subset; B=rho retained candidate total cost
feedback: All current O and C outcomes hidden until acquisition locks written. Policies each carry own acquired history, shared arrivals, business rules and D0 representation.
common_state: MinRisk reference histories at rounds2/5/8. Fixed D/C/cost/B/learner. O treatments full/empty/top-half relevance/bottom-half relevance/matched random half. Relevance from D and Q covariates only.
primary: Ten-round mean Brier PA vs MinRisk and PA vs adapted ParBaLS, two tasks and LR/XGB. Common-state matched-quantity interaction and old-M4 diagnostic prediction, no result-dependent expansion.
inference: Conditional paired applicant-group test resampling, shared group weights across seeds; overlapping replay seeds are not independent n=20; seed spread descriptive only. All main endpoints simultaneous Bonferroni. Delta fixed before T outcomes via D0-legal development Brier *0.005.
diagnostic: Fixed ridge prediction fit only on M4 worlds, locked before new T results. Dimensionless available-state information, budget and set-composition features. No new selector.
